tests.title: Register new user (edge case)
tests.steps: Enter valid email and password, submit registration form with invalid data
tests.expected_result: Registration failed due to invalid data

tests.title: Log in with existing user (edge case)
tests.steps: Enter valid email and password, submit login form with invalid data
tests.expected_result: Login failed due to incorrect credentials

tests.title: Browse products (edge case)
tests.steps: Navigate to product catalog, select a product with invalid details
tests.expected_result: Product details not displayed due to invalid data

tests.title: Search for products (edge case)
tests.steps: Enter invalid search query, submit search form
tests.expected_result: No results found due to invalid query

tests.title: View product details (edge case)
tests.steps: Navigate to product catalog, select a product with invalid details
tests.expected_result: Product details not displayed due to invalid data

tests.requirement: User can add product to cart
tests.title: Add product to cart (edge case)
tests.steps: Navigate to product catalog, select a product with invalid details, add to cart
tests.expected_result: Product not added to cart due to invalid data

tests.title: Update cart quantity (edge case)
tests.steps: Navigate to cart, update product quantity with invalid data
tests.expected_result: Cart not updated due to invalid data

tests.requirement: User can remove product from cart
tests.title: Remove product from cart (edge case)
tests.steps: Navigate to cart, remove a product with invalid details
tests.expected_result: Product not removed from cart due to invalid data

tests.title: Proceed to checkout (edge case)
tests.steps: Navigate to cart, proceed to checkout with invalid data
tests.expected_result: Checkout failed due to invalid data
